fields.columns: | columns event.time, event.type, site.name, agent.uuid, src.process.storyline.id, src.process.user, src.process.uid, src.process.cmdline, src.ip.address, src.port.number, dst.ip.address, dst.port.number, src.process.parent.cmdline, tgt.process.cmdline
fields.description: Detects usage of "rar" to add files to an archive for potential compression. An adversary may compress data (e.g. sensitive documents) that is collected prior to exfiltration in order to make it portable and minimize the amount of data sent over the network.
fields.name: Files Added To An Archive Using Rar.EXE
fields.query: event.type="Process Creation" and (endpoint.os="windows" and (tgt.process.image.path contains "\\rar.exe" and tgt.process.cmdline contains " a "))
